Build a 90 day roadmap for shared services AI.
For Lakeshore Holdings, a 90-day shared services AI roadmap is best anchored to the four active initiatives already in motion rather than built as a greenfield program.
• The highest-value starting point is the Corporate ERP and HCM controls modernization, where AI-assisted anomaly detection and workflow automation can deliver measurable control improvements within the first 30 days against a budget and owner already confirmed.
• Treasury cash visibility standardization and the Legal contract lifecycle foundation are natural Days 31–60 targets — both are data-readiness plays where AI accelerates pattern recognition across the portfolio, and both carry defined sponsors who can absorb a phased rollout.
• The Portfolio data foundation, currently in build phase, is the 60–90 day unlock: without it, AI outputs across the four operating companies remain ungoverned and difficult to audit at the holdco level.
The $11.8M innovation IT subset is the most credible funding signal for this sequence; owner alignment and operating-company data sharing terms have not been confirmed here and represent the live planning gap.
Branch: Tower to size value and spend by initiative; Moves to sequence execution across the four workstreams; Intelligence for tradeoff options if budget or sponsor alignment shifts; Source if vendor selection for any AI tooling requires validation.
